responsibility: Contains the primary AVR RTL machine description for instruction selection, expansion, splitting, peepholes, operand printing semantics, and instruction attributes. It defines the target’s core insn patterns, unspec codes, register constants, branch and length attributes, specialized expanders and peepholes, and includes the companion predicate/constraint files plus the fixed-point and 64-bit subdescriptions, making this the central `.md` file that maps GCC RTL operations to AVR assembly forms and late transformations.
same_name_distinction: This is the declarative machine-description source for AVR instruction selection and attributes: unlike avr.cc it is not the hook/helper implementation file, unlike avr.h it is not a C/C++ macro interface header, and unlike avr.opt it does not define user options; it encodes RTL patterns, peepholes, unspecs, and insn attributes consumed by generated backend code.
